api_key.hint: Enter the API key here, or leave empty to read the VOLCENGINE_API_KEY environment variable.

base_url.hint: Full Seedream image generation endpoint, including /api/v3/images/generations. The plugin uses this address as-is for both text generation and edits. Reload the plugin after changes.

timeout_seconds.hint: HTTP timeout in seconds for generation and image downloads. The tool waits for the POST body to finish sending, then generation and delivery continue in the background. Failed requests are not automatically retried.

max_storage_gb.hint: Before each API request, prune oldest archives when storage exceeds this limit. Protect queued, generating and undelivered requests. New images may exceed the limit until the next request.

allow_non_admin_private_chat.description: Allow non-administrators to generate images in private chats
allow_non_admin_private_chat.hint: Disabled by default. When disabled, any call to this plugin's tools by a non-administrator in a private chat returns: Non-administrator users are currently only allowed to generate images in group chats. Administrator private chats and group chats continue to follow the existing rules. Reload the plugin after changes.

sliding_window.hint: Nonnegative integer. Shared by per-user and total quotas. Set to 0 to skip both checks.

per_user_max_images.description: Maximum images per user in the sliding window
per_user_max_images.hint: Nonnegative integer. Counts requested images, including pending and failed jobs. A quota of 0 rejects requests through the normal quota check; the tool remains available. Ignored when the window is 0. Rejected requests are not recorded. Administrators bypass this check. Uses the latest 1000 receipts per user.

total_max_images.description: Maximum images for all users in the sliding window
total_max_images.hint: Nonnegative integer. Counts all accepted images, including administrator requests. Only ordinary users are restricted. Set to 0 to reject ordinary-user requests when the sliding window is enabled. Uses the latest 1000 total receipts.
